nvitk.gui.viz.centerline.split_label_at_junctions(label_volume: numpy.ndarray, source_label_id: int, centerline_polyline: numpy.ndarray, junction_coords: numpy.ndarray, *, new_label_start=None) → tuple[numpy.ndarray, list[int]]¶

Split source_label_id into new labels at junctions along centerline_polyline.

Junction voxels are removed from the source label; each branch between cuts is rasterized with a new label id (qvtpy-style branch split).

nvitk.gui.viz.centerline.POLYLINE_SHAPES_META = 'nvitk_centerline_polylines'¶
nvitk.gui.viz.centerline.DEFAULT_POLYLINE_LAYER = 'Centerline polylines'¶
nvitk.gui.viz.centerline.centerline_mask_to_polylines(centerline: numpy.ndarray, *, labels: list[int] | None = None, min_branch_points: int | None = None, reskeletonize: bool = False, smooth: bool = True, smooth_window: int = 5) → list[dict[str, Any]]¶

Convert a labeled centerline mask into connected branch polylines.

Uses compute_connected_centerline_tree() so each label keeps its main path plus every unique junction-split branch (shared only at bifurcation voxels — no dropped corridors).

Parameters:

min_branch_points – Drop edges shorter than this many voxels. None / <= 0 keeps every edge with at least 2 points.
